value="<b style="font-size:12px">Control activities</b><br>Regular, on wdf-control-&lt;build id&gt;, at most 5 attempts, backoff 1 s to 60 s:<br> load_plan, cache_lookup, cache_record, cache_invalidate,<br> commit, index_checkpoint, build_index<br>Local, no attempt limit, backoff 1 s to 600 s:<br> place (the placer), emit (events and the status move)<br>A typed error is an ApplicationError whose type is its code,<br>so the workflow sees OUTPUT_UPLOAD_FAILED and retries the attempt." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="136" width="440" x="30" y="700" as="geometry" /> div.div:
Control activities
Regular, on wdf-control-<build id>, at most 5 attempts, backoff 1 s to 60 s:
load_plan, cache_lookup, cache_record, cache_invalidate,
commit, index_checkpoint, build_index
Local, no attempt limit, backoff 1 s to 600 s:
place (the placer), emit (events and the status move)
A typed error is an ApplicationError whose type is its code,
so the workflow sees OUTPUT_UPLOAD_FAILED and retries the attempt.

div.div:
Worked example: one simulate task placed by StaticPlacer
Plan task sim-0: simulate, 250m, 384 MiB, run timeout 900 s
place -> queue wdf-simulate, memory class 384Mi, not escalated
schedule-to-start 1,800 s, doubling at each re-place to 43,200 s
start-to-close 900 + 120 margin = 1,020 s, heartbeat 60 s
run_task: 1 attempt, WAIT_CANCELLATION_COMPLETED
At 385 MiB: Unschedulable insufficient_memory, budget none

div.div: An author pushes a source bundle with a JSON DAG definition, and compile is the first task of every job, skipped on a compile-cache hit. The workflow owns dependencies, retries and the task backlog. Placement is a local activity whose answer is recorded in history, and each task runs as one single-attempt activity on the returned pool queue, so the retry loop lives in the workflow. A budget exhausted by a task whose plan checkpoint flag is set pauses the job and keeps its checkpoint, otherwise independent branches drain and the job fails. Control activities run on the control queue of the build, and events leave through the emit local activity.
